name: Brevan Electronics
old_description: Celebrating 40 years of excellence, Brevan Electronics specializes in passives, interconnects, and electromechanical components, along with custom cable harness assemblies and PCB assembly solutions, delivering quality, reliability, and innovation to industries worldwide.
about:
Brevan Electronics is headquartered in Nashua, New Hampshire. The company was formed in 1983 as a distributor of high-technology electronic components for original equipment manufacturers. It is a woman-owned business led by CEO Michelle Dufoe.

Today Brevan operates as a global distributor and value-added service provider. Its core offerings include authorized distribution of passives, interconnects, and electromechanical components, along with custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and PCB assembly. The company also provides supply chain services such as bill-of-materials management, global sourcing, vendor-managed inventory, excess inventory liquidation, and shortage solutions. Through its subsidiaries Micro Informatica (serving Latin America and the Caribbean since 1985, acquired in 2025) and Falcon Electronics (specializing in aerospace and defense semiconductors, acquired in 2024), Brevan extends its reach into harsh-environment markets.

The customer base spans original equipment manufacturers across the electronics industry, with a noted focus on aerospace and defense programs through Falcon Electronics. Brevan’s authorized distribution lines cover top component manufacturers, and its proprietary cloud-based sourcing platform grants access to billions of parts worldwide.

Brevan differentiates itself through its woman-owned status and a culture that emphasizes employee growth and professional development under Dufoe’s leadership. The company promotes a “BRVN Guarantee” of highest-quality service, backed by 24/7 real-time quoting from dedicated account specialists and a proprietary sourcing technology that enables rapid response to component shortages.

name: BrightLife Electric NV
old_description: BrightLife Electric NV was founded in 2020 during the global pandemic with a vision to build something lasting. As a woman-owned, family-operated company, I poured everything into creating a business rooted in integrity, reliability, and long-term relationships.
about:
BrightLife Electric NV is based in Sparks, Nevada, and was founded in 2020 during the global pandemic. The company is woman-owned and family-operated, started by Shannon, who grew up in Spanish Springs in a family of contractors and spent years learning the electrical trade before launching the business with a vision to build a lasting, integrity-driven operation.

The firm provides a full range of residential and commercial electrical services, from troubleshooting single outlets and panel upgrades to complete rewiring, new-construction wiring, and commercial tenant improvements. Its 13-person crew handles lighting installations, security and surge protection, EV charger and RV outlet hookups, dedicated circuits, and lighting retrofits. The team works on projects of all sizes, offering free estimates and maintaining current licensing, bonding, and insurance (License #0087070).

BrightLife serves homeowners, property managers, and commercial contractors across Reno, Sparks, Spanish Springs, Washoe County, Carson City, and surrounding Northern Nevada communities. Typical customers include residential clients needing repairs or remodels, builders on new housing developments, and businesses requiring tenant improvements, lighting retrofits, or EV charging infrastructure.

The company emphasizes honest, transparent communication and a family-first culture that provides livable wages and benefits to its electricians. Shannon notes that her woman-owned perspective brings a different approach to attention to detail and customer service. This philosophy has earned consistent community recognition, including five consecutive years as a Nextdoor Neighborhood Favorite and multiple Best of Reno awards.

name: Brookfield Wire, LLC
old_description: Since 1947, Brookfield Wire has been a reputable wire company, specializing in drawing and shaping wire to meet the highest quality standards. Renowned for its expertise in wire drawing techniques and rigorous quality control, Brookfield Wire serves various industries, including aerospace and agriculture. The company’s nickel-based alloys and stainless steel wire are trusted in demanding applications globally.
about:
Brookfield Wire, LLC operates from a 40-acre site in West Brookfield, Massachusetts, where it has been drawing and shaping wire since 1947. The company was founded as a domestic manufacturer of cold-drawn stainless steel, nickel, and nickel-alloy wire, and today runs over 70,000 square feet of manufacturing space supported by a 15-acre solar array that helps power the facility.

The core business is precision wire drawing and forming, producing round, flat, and custom-shaped wire in diameters from 0.006 to 0.250 inches. The plant houses electric strand annealing furnaces and draws countless tons of stainless steel, nickel, Inconel, and other alloys each year, offering more than 50 standard alloys plus hard-to-find grades sourced globally from domestic and NATO-qualified mills. Finished wire ships on spools, reels, coils, Acro Pacs, and cut-to-length packages.

Customers span aerospace, agriculture, medical, automotive, oil and gas, building and construction, welding, jewelry, and telecommunications. Typical applications include spring wire, welding electrode core wire, medical component wire, fine cable sheathing, slickline and downhole line, brush wire, and fastener wire for nails, staples, and screws.

Brookfield Wire emphasizes DFARS-compliant materials, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and quick lead times as key differentiators. The company’s seven-decade track record, extensive alloy inventory, and willingness to source obscure grades are presented as reasons customers choose them over brokers or offshore suppliers.

name: Bunty LLC
old_description: Founded in 2000, Bunty LLC possesses 16 years of practical experience. Our flexible, highly adaptive business model gives us impressive production capacities coupled with reduced overhead and agility. We strive to furnish our customers with comprehensive business solutions which meet or exceed their needs.
about:
Bunty LLC is headquartered in Greenville, South Carolina. The company was founded in 2000 by Rajeev Jindal, a Clemson University engineering graduate with corporate manufacturing experience at International Paper, Milliken & Company, and Owens Corning. Jindal started the business as a contract manufacturing firm, which later evolved into a full-service custom machined, forged, and cast metal parts fabrication enterprise. Jeffrey Pham, a Babson College graduate and former consultant to the U.S. Air Force and DaimlerChrysler, serves as Managing Director.

The company provides a broad range of metalworking services, including custom forging (closed-die, cold forging), casting (die, investment, permanent mold, sand, centrifugal, and lost-foam), CNC machining (5-axis, milling, turning, EDM wire cutting), heat treatment, surface treatments (anodizing, plating, powder coating, DLC), and fabrication with tooling. Bunty operates domestic and overseas manufacturing, warehousing, and inspection facilities, supporting production from prototype through full-run volumes. No specific facility size or headcount is disclosed.

Bunty serves the automotive, aerospace, energy, medical, and food-processing industries. Its customer base includes the world’s largest tire manufacturer, a leading transmission supplier to a major Japanese automaker, Tier I automotive manufacturers of shocks, brakes, drivetrain components, and mirror assemblies, as well as producers of stainless-steel parts for food processing that meet FDA standards.

The company emphasizes a flexible, adaptive business model that combines global sourcing with reduced overhead and agility. It highlights rapid turnaround—offering delivery of stocked parts within one to three days—volume discounts, an extensive inventory of metal shapes, and rigorous process control protocols certified to AS9100D and ISO 9001:2015. Bunty positions itself as a partner that brings global manufacturing capabilities to small and mid-sized businesses.

name: Business Furniture + Co.
old_description: At Business Furniture + Co., we’ve been shaping the way people work since 1922. With over a century of experience and a future-focused mindset, we specialize in creating workspaces that help people thrive—whether in corporate offices, healthcare environments, or educational spaces. As a proud woman-owned business led by Mary Beth Oakes and Suzanne Bentley, we combine deep industry roots with a fresh, human-centered approach to design and change management.
about:
Business Furniture + Co. is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, with additional locations in Dayton, Ohio, and Noblesville and Fishers, Indiana. The company was founded in 1922 and has operated continuously for over a century. In 1987, Dick Oakes purchased the business from John Ober after a 20-year career as a sales executive at Steelcase. Today it is a certified woman-owned enterprise led by CEO and co-owner Mary Beth Oakes and President and co-owner Suzanne Bentley.

The firm provides end-to-end workplace solutions, including space planning, furniture procurement, installation, project management, and workplace strategy. Through its Choreo division, it delivers change-management services that guide organizations through cultural and spatial transformations. As an authorized Steelcase partner, it leverages research-driven product lines to outfit corporate offices, healthcare facilities, K-12 and higher-education campuses, and senior-living communities. The team includes specialists in design, operations, business development, safety, and quality, operating across multiple showrooms and a distribution center.

Clients span corporate, healthcare, education, and senior-living sectors. Concrete examples include St. Mary's Children Center (referenced in leadership bios), K-12 school districts served by a dedicated business-development team, and higher-education institutions. The company also supports workplace strategy engagements for organizations undergoing mergers, relocations, or cultural shifts.

The company's stated differentiator is its belief that "space shapes behavior, behaviors create culture, and culture drives results." This philosophy, combined with a century of institutional knowledge and a human-centered design approach, is presented as the foundation for creating environments where collaboration and innovation occur naturally.

name: C & S Plastics LLC
old_description: The C&S management team is composed of people experienced in the injection molding industry. The management team collectively has over 90 years of experience in the automotive and plastic injection molding industries.
about:
C & S Plastics LLC operates from a 150,000-square-foot facility in Fayetteville, Tennessee, with an additional 20,000-square-foot outdoor storage pad. The company was founded in 2003 and has since focused on plastic injection molding for the automotive sector. Its management team brings a collective 90 years of experience in automotive and injection molding, though individual founders are not named publicly.

The shop runs 30 injection molding machines ranging from 100 to 950 tons of clamping force. Twenty-eight are full-electric units from Niigata and Toyo, supplemented by one hybrid electric-hydraulic Nissei press and one hydraulic Mitsubishi machine. Every press is equipped with a Star Automation robot for part handling, and four overhead cranes (two 5-ton, one 10-ton, and one 10-ton with a 5-ton helper) support tooling changes and maintenance.

C & S serves as a Tier 2 automotive supplier, producing plastic components for domestic and export vehicle programs. The company does not disclose specific OEM customers but emphasizes its IATF 16949:2016 quality registration and a commitment to zero-defect production across all shifts.

The firm positions itself on competitive pricing, 100 percent on-time delivery, and a quality system staffed by dedicated technicians on every production shift. Its stated goal is to be the best possible second-tier supplier to the automotive industry.

name: C M Manufacturing
old_description: We are a leader in the manufacturing of high strength steel and non-ferrous parts in the aerospace industry. You can count on CM Manufacturing for all your precision machining needs delivered on time and on budget.
about:
CM Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1986 in Missoula, Montana by Richard Johnson, a retired United States Air Force officer who served as Commander of the Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA) in Cleveland. After a career that included program management at Cleveland Pneumatic on the SH-60B and EA-6B aircraft programs, Johnson established the company to apply his aerospace expertise to precision machining. The business remains family-owned, with Johnson's son Ken joining in 1996 and now serving as CEO and owner.

The shop specializes in fracture-critical and flight-safety-critical landing gear components for nearly every aircraft flown by the U.S. military and many foreign air forces. It machines high-strength steels such as 300M, 4340, and 4330; nickel alloys including Inconel, 13-8PH, and 17-4PH; plus aluminum and Delrin. Production runs on rigid Mazak equipment, and the company states it commonly holds tolerances of ±0.0001 inch. Inspection capabilities include multiple coordinate measuring machines (Brown & Sharpe G2000, Mitutoyo Crysta-Plus M574, Global S Green 9.12.8), optical and digital comparators (Starrett HB400 and HDV400-M3-CNC), a VICI vertical vision system, and a full suite of height gages, bore gauges, and thread gages.

Customers span the aerospace and defense sectors, including major aircraft manufacturers and the Defense Logistics Agency. The company emphasizes long-term vendor relationships and a proactive scheduling module to meet delivery commitments.

Johnson founded the business on a legacy of quality, precision, and craftsmanship developed during his military service and subsequent industry roles. That ethos was passed to Ken Johnson during 18 years working alongside his father before Richard's passing in 2014, and it continues to drive the company's focus on on-time, on-budget delivery of critical components.

name: C&K PlasticsThermoforming Georgia
old_description: Georgia Thermoforming by C&K Plastics. Experts in Large Plastic Parts thermoformed on-site.  Serving OEM manufacturers since 1963 with twin sheet formed plastic parts, vacuum forming, pressure forming and twin sheet thermoformed plastic parts.
about:
Founded in 1963 in Conyers, Georgia, C+K Plastics by Georgia Thermoforming operates a 95,000-square-foot manufacturing facility east of Atlanta. A second plant in Metuchen, New Jersey mirrors the equipment and capabilities, allowing tooling to move between sites for added capacity and freight savings.

The company specializes in large-format thermoforming, offering vacuum forming, pressure forming, twin-sheet forming, and heavy-gauge vacuum forming for parts up to 16 feet long in gauges from .080 to .780 inch. Its Conyers plant houses advanced equipment including a Zero-Sag machine—the first of its kind in the U.S. for automated large twin-sheet forming—along with CNC trimmers and robotics. Secondary operations such as CNC trimming take projects from concept to finished product, supporting both low- and high-volume runs.

Primary customers are OEM manufacturers in the automotive, transportation, and aerospace sectors. A noted specialty is returnable packaging for automotive manufacturers to transport parts to assembly plants. The firm also serves broader industrial markets requiring durable, lightweight thermoplastic components.

C+K Plastics emphasizes technological advancement to deliver innovative, cost-effective thermoforming solutions. The dual-plant network shortens lead times and enables just-in-time and blanket-order fulfillment, while the Zero-Sag machine provides a unique capability for large twin-sheet parts with enclosed cavities suited for structural applications.

name: CM Fabricating
old_description: Established in 2015, CM Fabricating is your reliable metal fabrication partner in Kansas City, MO. As a local, veteran-owned fabrication shop, we pride ourselves on delivering quality craftsmanship and superior service at an affordable price. Our skilled fabricators and certified welders specialize in a range of services, tailored to meet the exact specifications of our valued customers.
about:
CM Fabricating is a veteran-owned metal fabrication shop based in Kansas City, Missouri. The company was established in 2015 as a local fabrication and welding business serving the Kansas City metropolitan area, founded to deliver quality craftsmanship and affordable service to the region.

The shop offers custom metal fabrication, welding (including mobile welding), powder coating, and CNC cutting services. Its team of fabricators and certified welders brings more than 40 years of combined experience to projects ranging from ornamental ironwork to structural components. The facility uses CNC cutting equipment for intricate patterns and large-scale projects, while a mobile welding unit allows on-site repairs and installations. No facility size or headcount figures are publicly disclosed.

CM Fabricating works with residential, commercial, and industrial clients across Kansas City and surrounding communities such as Independence, Riverside, Gladstone, and Roeland Park. The customer base includes homeowners, contractors, and businesses seeking custom metalwork for architectural, structural, and decorative applications. Past projects cited in customer reviews include custom railings, range hoods, wine shelving units, stair railings, and fabrication for both personal acreage and professional job sites.

The company emphasizes fast turnaround, offering same-day service and free estimates. It is licensed and insured, and provides a 10 percent discount for veterans and first responders. According to the company, its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction sets it apart, backed by licensed and insured operations and a policy of same-day service availability.
